infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Tuck uses the camera to photograph your items and scan box QR labels.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Tuck uses your location to fill in the move's from/to addresses.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Tuck uses the microphone for hands-free Streaming Mode — say an item and it's added to the box.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Tuck transcribes your voice on-device in Streaming Mode to fill in item names, quantities and values.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tuck can access your photo library to attach existing photos to your items.
